title: Mark the treatment on the aesthetic map
summary: Points, areas and lines on the face or body, with dose, lot, notes and per-zone history.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Tap the aesthetic session
steps.details: You can tell it by its status (Draft, In treatment, Ready to close, Closed…). Tapping it expands it. If the patient has none, create one first with Create → Aesthetic session.

steps.title: Continue session
steps.details: Resumes at the first step still missing. A closed or void session opens read-only.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.details: It stays locked until at least one consent is signed.

steps.title: Region, view and background
steps.details: Face or body, the view, and what's behind: the model (with its skin tone) or today's photo.

steps.title: Active service
steps.details: What you mark goes to this service; the eye hides or shows it. Those not signed show a lock and can't be marked.

steps.title: Tools
steps.details: Select and move, point, area and line, undo and redo (Ctrl+Z), show the zones and show the previous session's marks. Each service starts with its configured tool.

steps.title: Map
steps.details: A point: one tap. An area: tap the vertices and close on the first one or with Enter. A line: tap the start and the end. The zone is detected on its own. Tapping an empty zone with Select shows its history.

steps.title: Mark details
steps.details: Appears when a mark is selected: quantity, zone, depth, technique and note. "Mirror" duplicates it on the other side and "Change on this mark" uses another product or lot. It warns if the maximum is exceeded, the interval was not respected or the lot expired, but it does not block.

steps.title: Summary
steps.details: Each service with its total and marks. Tap one to enter product, lot and expiry just once for all its marks.

steps.title: Notes
steps.details: Timestamped notes while you work, with voice dictation and frequent phrases.

steps.title: History
steps.details: What was applied to each zone in earlier sessions (last 12 months).
